pre_sedation_assessment: Consent in chart (right patient, site and procedure)
IV access obtained and line patent
Pre-sedation PRN medicines given (Ondansetron, Midazolam, Fentanyl PRN)
Relevant past medical history reviewed; document ASA class
Document last meal and patient weight
Document planned sedative dose and paralytic dose

difficult_airway_assessment.BVM — ROMAN: Radiation/Restriction; Obstruction/Obesity/OSA; Mask seal/Male/Mallampati; Aged; No teeth
difficult_airway_assessment.Extraglottic device — RODS: Restriction; Obstruction/Obesity; Distorted anatomy; Short thyromental distance
difficult_airway_assessment.Direct laryngoscopy — LEMON: Look externally; Evaluate 3-3-2; Mallampati; Obstruction/Obesity; Neck mobility

equipment: Patient pre-oxygenation: nasal cannula at >15 L/min or non-rebreather mask
ETCO2 and pulse oximetry with an adequate waveform
Cardiac monitor with blood pressure every 3–5 minutes and as required
RSI equipment: laryngoscope blade, ETT, stylet, syringe, extraglottic device and lubricant
Ventilation rescue equipment: nasal airway, oral airway and BVM connected to oxygen

management_steps.details: Complete the bedside-equipment, pre-sedation, difficult-airway and team checklists before medication administration.
Use ETCO2, pulse oximetry with an adequate waveform, continuous cardiac monitoring and blood pressure measurement every 3–5 minutes and as required.

Position the patient and suction as required; perform jaw thrust; insert nasal trumpets; use BVM ventilation; insert an oral airway; consider reversal with naloxone or flumazenil; proceed to RSI or an extraglottic device if required.

warnings: Ketofol note from the HJH checklist: ketamine plus propofol; do not mix in the same syringe.

embedded_drugs.protocol_dose: 0.1–0.3 mg/kg for pain; 1–2 mg/kg IV for sedation
embedded_drugs.precautions: Hypertension, CHF, CAD, schizophrenia, emesis and emergence; consider midazolam 1–2 mg PRN

embedded_drugs.protocol_dose: Initial dose 0.5 mg/kg in elderly patients or 1.0 mg/kg standard dose
embedded_drugs.precautions: Soy/egg allergy, hypotension, tachycardia and elderly patients
Pregnancy, delayed onset and opiate co-administration

embedded_drugs.protocol_dose: Initial dose 1 mg/kg: 0.5 mg/kg propofol plus 0.5 mg/kg ketamine
embedded_drugs.precautions: See ketamine and propofol precautions; do not mix in the same syringe
